##### Project general facts

Maserati Island is a branded private island resort community conceived as a curated collection of waterfront homes, where every journey begins with a sea crossing to a dedicated arrival jetty. Low-rise residential buildings with sweeping curved terraces and layered, sculpted balconies wrap around sandy beaches, lagoons and boat moorings, so that most homes look directly onto open water and the city skyline. The residential offering ranges from compact studios to one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments, crowned by a limited collection of exclusive penthouses and complemented by a separate villa collection of Ocean Floating Villas set directly on the water, Light House Villas and Tree Villas framed by landscaped gardens.

Island life is organised around leisure by the sea. Residents have access to a refined beach club with loungers and shaded cabanas, several swimming pools, a floating restaurant with panoramic water views, a retail promenade designed as a lifestyle destination, a dedicated fitness studio and a kids play area built around a central tree sculpture. Larger residences enjoy wraparound open-air balconies with private plunge pools or jacuzzis, outdoor lounges, sunbeds, outdoor dining zones and wellness corners, while a dedicated welcome centre marks the start of the resident and guest journey to the island.

Interiors follow a calm resort palette of sand, ivory and warm timber, with marble surfaces and floor-to-ceiling glazing that opens living rooms and bedrooms to the sea, and apartments come partly furnished. Open-plan living and dining areas lead to show kitchens, master bedrooms are paired with walk-in dressing areas and bathrooms, and the largest homes add maid rooms, storage and separate powder rooms, creating a polished, hotel-inspired setting throughout.

##### Location description and benefits

The World Islands is an exclusive man-made archipelago set off the Jumeirah coastline, where individual islands are arranged in the outline of a world map. The location offers a rare sense of seclusion while staying within sight of the city: Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah, Jumeirah Bay and the Downtown Dubai skyline all sit on the horizon, and the surrounding waters are lined with some of the most prestigious resort and residential addresses in Dubai.

Access to the island is by sea, with frequent scheduled boat transfers and water taxis connecting to marinas and jetties along the Jumeirah coast, and private yacht arrivals adding to the resort-style experience. The island itself is entirely car-free, with residents and guests moving between buildings, beaches and amenities by buggy, which keeps the community quiet and private. Once ashore on the mainland, Jumeirah Beach Road and Sheikh Zayed Road link residents to Downtown Dubai, DIFC, Dubai Marina and both international airports, while premium schools, clinics, beach clubs, fine dining and the leading shopping malls of the city are all within easy reach.

The World Islands is a freehold destination open to international buyers, positioned at the very top of the Dubai luxury market. The scarcity of private island homes, strong appeal to high-net-worth buyers and the steady demand for exclusive holiday homes and premium short-stay rentals make the location well suited both for a personal seaside retreat and for long-term capital preservation.
